Container.Name: strata
Container.Overview: Strata runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on one NVIDIA GPU plus system RAM and serves an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API, a chat page and a live monitor.[br][br] [b]Requirements:[/b] the Nvidia Driver plugin on driver 580 or newer, an RTX 30/40/50 card (compute capability 8.0+), 48-62 GB of free RAM depending on the model, and about 92 GB of disk on an SSD pool.[br][br] [b]First run (once):[/b] set [i]Post Arguments[/i] to [b]init[/b] under Advanced View, then start the container and watch the log. It downloads about 92 GB and builds the pack and the MTP layer, which takes a few hours. Resumable: if it stops, start it again. When the log says "Init done", clear Post Arguments and start the container again to run the server.[br][br] [b]No API key by default:[/b] anyone who can reach the port can use the model. Set STRATA_API_KEY and run init again (no re-download) to require one.
Container.Requires: Nvidia Driver plugin (driver 580 or newer). Do not pin CPUs: the engine sets its own thread affinity and breaks inside a cpuset.

Config.Name: WebUI / API port
Config.Description: Chat page, monitor and the /v1 API. No API key is set by default, so keep this LAN-only.

Config.Name: Model data
Config.Description: About 92 GB for IQ3_S. Use a direct pool path (/mnt/cache/... or /mnt/POOLNAME/...), not /mnt/user: the engine reads experts from the GGUF while it runs. Needs rw for init; it can be set to ro afterwards.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Run config, calibration and the engine log (strata-TAG.log). Look here first when the server will not start.

Config.Name: GPU
Config.Description: Your card's UUID (GPU-xxxxxxxx-...) from the Nvidia Driver plugin page or nvidia-smi -L. Pin exactly one card.

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: IQ3_S: 84 GB download, needs 62 GB RAM. IQ3_XXS: 60 GB RAM. IQ2_XS and Q2_0: 48 GB RAM. Changing it needs init again.

Config.Name: Model family
Config.Description: qwen; swift (thinks shorter); coder (half the experts, about 32 GB RAM). Changing it needs init again.

Config.Name: Context length
Config.Description: 262144 needs more than 90 GB of RAM with IQ3_S, otherwise setup caps it at 131072. Changing it needs init again.

Config.Name: Vision
Config.Description: Image input. gpu downloads a 0.9 GB encoder. Changing it needs init again.

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Empty = no key. When set, /v1/* requires it as Authorization: Bearer or x-api-key. Run init once after setting it the first time; to remove it, clear this AND run init again.

Config.Name: KV cache type
Config.Description: int8, or q4_0 for half the KV memory and slightly less precision. Changing it needs init again.

Config.Name: Prompt cache checkpoints
Config.Description: Checkpoints kept between requests, about 118 MB of RAM each. Changing it needs init again.

Config.Name: Prompt cache interval
Config.Description: Also checkpoint every N freshly read prompt tokens. Changing it needs init again.

Config.Name: NVIDIA driver capabilities
Config.Description: Must include utility: the entrypoint and setup refuse to run without nvidia-smi.
